_about: Source of truth for generated voice. Story narration: tools/tts_gemini.ps1 (Gemini) reads this and story.json. Battle cries ('calls'): tools/tts_sarvam.ps1 (Sarvam, native Hindi) when calls_engine is 'sarvam'. Both write audio/voice/<id>.wav and skip files that already exist; delete a wav to regenerate it. Then run tools/trim_voice.gd and verify with tools/tts_check.ps1.
_style_note: gemini-3.8-flash-tts reads any style prefix aloud and rejects system instructions; 2.5-flash-preview-tts treats a short 'Say ...:' prefix as direction. Verify every take with tools/tts_check.ps1.

narrator.style: Narrate slowly in a deep, warm storyteller's voice:

hero.style: Say firmly and powerfully, like a warrior casting a spell:

tamra.style: Say with quiet determination, like a young warrior:

maa.style: Say gently and warmly, like a loving mother:

maa_echo.style: Whisper softly, as if from far away:

king.style: Say coldly and menacingly, like a cruel king:

king_echo.style: Whisper coldly, as if from far away:

_calls_note: Gemini's hero voice gave KAVACH an English accent and UDAAN a doubled take (owner, 2026-10-25), so the cries moved to Sarvam's native Hindi voices. One speaker for all eight keeps the hero consistent.

story_voices._about: Story voices for tools/tts_story.py (gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview, emotion tags inline). Owner: no whispering; Tamra is a 12-year-old boy. 'age' lists the apparent ages the listening check accepts.
